heading: 17.3 `float64`-only storage is `nofpu`-hostile. **BLOCKER.**
text:
### 17.3 `float64`-only storage is `nofpu`-hostile. **BLOCKER.** [LUNI.17.3]

Every dimension but `time`, `data` and the currencies is `storage float64` (§4.1). No-FPU targets
(Cortex-M0+, low-end RISC-V) have no hardware `float64` → softfloat for *every*
`celsius`/`meter`/`watt` field, and the `storage` clause offers no fixed-point /
scaled-integer option. Recommend: admit a fixed-point storage backing
(e.g. `storage int32 scale <rational>` / Q-format) selectable under `nofpu`,
with conversion factors baked to that representation. Pairs with
`realtime`/`linear_scan: false`.
